name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for go-karts in his hometown of Montreal. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, focusing on vehicle dynamics and aerodynamics, leading him to an entry-level position with a Formula Ford team. His meticulous attention to detail and ability to quickly diagnose mechanical issues propelled him through the ranks, eventually landing him in NASCAR. 

At Richard Childress Racing, Jean-Pierre is known for his data-driven approach to race engineering. He meticulously analyzes telemetry and track conditions to optimize car setups, always pushing for marginal gains. While respected for his technical prowess, he's also cultivated a reputation for being a strong communicator, adept at translating complex engineering concepts into actionable feedback for the driver.
